cases.name: 12 trees in a straight row
cases.text: You have 12 trees but they stand in a straight row. For a natural forest, spread z with random(-15, 15) too. The loop idea is down: enemy waves and level generation work the same way. +50 XP

cases.name: empty editor
cases.text: The scene has 0 trees and no loop. Put a tree(...) inside for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) { ... }.

hints.text: The loop condition is i < 3, so it runs 3 times. Make that number bigger.
The trees all sit on z = 0, in one row. Spread both x and z with random(-15, 15).
Full answer: for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) { tree(random(-15, 15), random(-15, 15)); }
